custody_model: Users move assets into a Bitfinex Funding Wallet and place peer-to-peer funding offers that can be matched with margin traders or Bitfinex Borrow demand. Reviewed first-party materials describe platform matching, collateral and liquidation controls but do not establish a segregated bank-deposit or trust structure for the funding-provider claim.
yield_source: Funding providers receive interest paid by users who take their funding. Providers choose amount, rate and term, and Bitfinex deducts a funding fee from earned interest. Lending Pro automates management of offers in this same funding market.
risk_notes: Margin Funding is explicitly not risk-free. Bitfinex says collateral and liquidation systems reduce provider risk, but in an extreme market move where losses exceed collateral broadly enough, losses could ultimately be shared with funding providers. Funding availability, rates, term and eligibility also vary.

custody_model: Reviewed Poloniex materials describe subscription from exchange balances into flexible- or fixed-term Earn products and redemption or maturity back to the spot account. They do not establish a universal segregated bank-deposit or trust structure for all Earn products.
yield_source: Poloniex publishes product-specific estimated APYs and pays interest according to each flexible or fixed product's rules. The reviewed public sources do not establish one universal underlying yield-generation mechanism for all Poloniex Earn assets and periods.
risk_notes: Poloniex describes all Earn investment products as principal-protected, but its launch and related product notices also warn that cryptocurrency investment is subject to high market risk and users are responsible for losses. CYA therefore preserves principal-protection wording as an attributed product statement rather than a universal legal, custody or solvency guarantee. Fixed-term products can restrict early redemption and quotas/rates can change.
